why: Checked against RULES['Select Weapons'], RULES['Close-quarters'] and RULES['Extra Attacks'] in data.js, on all 20 units of both lists (node harness on app.html + data.js) and 24 made-up units. Literal parts: melee "or" between one model's weapons = 04.01 "While fighting: You must select one melee weapon that model has". "+" before every [EXTRA ATTACKS] weapon, and no divider for a model that has only [EXTRA ATTACKS] weapons = "you must select: All of that model's [EXTRA ATTACKS] weapons. One of that model's other melee weapons, if possible" (Wazdakka; Boss with Klaw + Jaws EA + Tail EA; Boss with only two EA). No "or" for MONSTER/VEHICLE (Beastboss Thump Gun + Slugga; a made-up Dread and Kans) = "(excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE models)". A weapon shared with models that have only it gets a scope ("Choppa or [Nob] Smash Hammer ×4" on the Breaka Boyz; made-up variants). A|B and B|C gives "A or [Nob] B or [Boss] C"; A|B, B|C, A|C returns null and the sentence is shown. INTERPRETATION (affects the Deffkoptas in both lists): the Close-quarters text limits the choice to one case: "can shoot using close-quarters shooting (10.06). When using another shooting type, for each model … you can only select one of the following: One or more of its [CLOSE-QUARTERS] weapons. One or more of its other ranged weapons." The ranged "or" ("Rokkit Launcha ×3 / or / Slugga ×3") has no condition, so it applies the either/or in close-quarters shooting too, which the text does not name for it. The ranged branch never returns null, so the old sentence's clause "in close-quarters shooting, Slugga only" (the fix from the earlier audit, key 7197939b6b12670c) no longer appears anywhere on the datasheet. (10.06's own text is not in data.js.) bug: the ranged "or" is one divider between all non-[CLOSE-QUARTERS] rows and all [CLOSE-QUARTERS] rows, with no check that the named models' weapons sit next to it (the melee branch has that check). Units where only some models have a pistol and another gun: 2× Nob [Kustom Shoota, Slugga], 5× Boy w/ Shoota, 3× Boy [Slugga] shows "Kustom Shoota ×2 / Shoota ×5 / or [Nob] / Slugga ×5". That reads as "Nob: Shoota or Slugga", but the Nob has no Shoota ("One or more of its other ranged weapons"). Same with Nob [Kombi, Slugga] + 5× Boy [Shoota] + Kaptin [Snazz, Slugga]: "Kombi / Shoota ×5 / Snazz / or [Nob, Kaptin] / Slugga ×2". Neither list has such a unit today. bug: the "+" scope is checked only against the models that carry the [EXTRA ATTACKS] weapon, not against the weapon row it is drawn after. 2× Nob [Big Choppa, Squig Jaws EA] + 4× Boy [Choppa] shows "Big Choppa ×2 / Choppa ×4 / + / Squig Jaws ×2" with no name, which reads as the Boyz adding Squig Jaws. 2× Nob [Big Choppa, Jaws EA] + 2× Boss [Klaw, Tail EA] shows "Big Choppa / Klaw / + Jaws / + Tail", a combination nobody has. Latent: no real unit mixes these. bug: scope (and carrier) names drop " w/…" (short), so two models lines with the same short name merge. useLine's nameOf kept them apart. 2× Boy w/ A [A,B] + 2× Boy w/ C [B,C] shows "A ×2 or [Boy] B ×4 or [Boy] C ×2", which reads as one Boy choosing among A, B, C. 4× Tankbusta [Rokkit] + 1× Tankbusta w/ Pistol [Rokkit, Pistol] shows "or [Tankbusta]", which names the four Tankbustas that have no pistol. The real lists' scopes are only "Nob", but carriers already read "Knucklebustas – Breaka Boy" and "Kustom Mega-blasta – Deffkopta". Latent, no change needed today: big = hasKw(u,'Monster'||'Vehicle') tests the whole (attached) unit's keywords, but the text says "for each model … (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE models)". A VEHICLE character leading Boyz [Shoota, Slugga] drops the Boyz' "or". No list has such a unit, and data.js has no per-model keywords. isCQ also counts a weapon as [CLOSE-QUARTERS] when any one of its profiles has it (Mork's Roar). That would matter only if Ghazghkull had another gun.
fix: In weaponJoins (all three changes tested in a harness copy; on the real lists only the Deffkoptas' "or" label and three carrier names change): 1) Name lines as useLine does: add `const nameOf = i => mine.some(j => j !== i && short(j) === short(i)) ? u.models[i].replace(/^\d+× /, '') : short(i);` and build lines with `name:nameOf(i)` instead of `name:short(i)`. 2) Ranged: replace `if(both.length && k > 0) joins[k] = { t:'or', rule:'Close-quarters', scope:scopeOf(both, order) };` with `if(both.length && k > 0){ if(scopeOf(both, order)) return null; joins[k] = { t:'or', rule:'Close-quarters', scope:'when using another shooting type' }; }`. This draws the divider only when every model in the part has the choice; otherwise useLine's per-model sentence is shown, which keeps the close-quarters-shooting clause. The label is the rule's own condition. 3) Extra Attacks: replace `if(ls.length) joins[k] = { t:'+', rule:'EXTRA ATTACKS', scope:scopeOf(ls, [b]) }; continue;` with `const ref = lines.filter(l => l.has.includes(b) || l.has.some(it => !isEA(it))); if(ls.length) joins[k] = { t:'+', rule:'EXTRA ATTACKS', scope: ls.length < ref.length ? [...new Set(ls.map(l => l.name))].join(', ') : '' }; continue;`. That gives "Choppa ×4 / + Nob / Squig Jaws ×2" and "+ Nob Jaws / + Boss Tail".
